input.title: Drop target of temporary expansion persists into next drag-and-drop
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - b
  - c
    - c1
    - c2
    - c3
```

1. Set the cursor to null (so `c` is collapsed).  
1. Drag `b` after `c` and hold until `c` expands. 
2. Cancel the drag. 
3. Drag `b` in the empty space below c.

## Current Behavior

Drop hover/target is out of place (as if below c3):

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/04dcfd2b-4886-4f02-b44e-7b659ffcf442)

If dragged below and left, the drop hover appears twice:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16d99900-1a07-4c9e-9f64-1671b72a2448)

## Expected Behavior

The drop hover and target should appear in the correct place:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f6e6965-5fb0-473a-8a21-8a22ee6539aa)
